notes.title: V1.143 Coffee and Hand Improvements Update
notes.content:
V1.143 Coffee and Hand Improvements Update

Added Fully functional coffee machine to all heavy cockpits,

Includes self-cleaning mechanism so you can continue fighting without worrying about your pot's cleanliness

Very drinkable,

Improved hand functionality,

Pointer finger extends now when moving to press anything with an open hand

Improvements to hand gestures as you approach objects makes for a much easier experience for people learning the system and even for those that have mastered it!

This small update is something we really wanted to do. Those who know us know that our last updates have been huge, mission-critical things, and we love to be adding new mechs, new maps, new game modes, new cockpits, entire custom paint systems, or whatever your favorite recent update was. However, with such a huge and monumental shift for the very essence of the game coming up, we wanted to spend some time towards shoring up the game as it is today, and we wanted to make something fun that we could all have a laugh together with before we jump deep into those waters. And so, I'm jacked to announce the coffee and hands update! We have a few more updates that will come before the next stage of the Iron Rebellion, but today we're bringing a cup of joe, some foundational improvements, and a quick update on our progress. That's pretty much everything from us, see you in the stars!

notes.title: Scout Cockpit & Heavy Cockpit – Incoming!
notes.content:
Cockpit Additions
New Scout-Class Cockpit

The Scout Cockpit is for pilots who move fast, hit hard, and vanish before the dust settles.

200° Bubble Screen HUD Near-panoramic vision for maximum situational awareness. See all evade all.

Stripped Down to the Brass. Minimal armor, zero excess weight. You’ll feel like you're flying a jet engine with joysticks. Agile, Fast, Exposed Accelerates harder, corners tighter, but takes hits like a paper kite. Ideal for scouting, flanking, or fast-cap missions.

Best For:

Solo strikes, scout roles, and pilots who don’t miss.
[hr][/hr]
New Heavy-Class Cockpit

Built like a bank vault with a trigger, the Heavy Cockpit is designed for dominance and long-haul engagements with reinforced plating-designed for front‑line durability.

Reinforced Slit-style Screen Offers narrow but ultra-protected visibility-less screen, more survival. Perfect for holding lines under fire and absorbing splash damage.

Built-In Living Quarters Integrated coffee maker, rations locker, and fold-down bunk.
Because when you're the last mech standing, comfort matters.

Best For:

Siege ops, objective holds, and last-mech-standing scenarios.

Taking hits so your squad doesn’t have to.


[hr][/hr]Massive Visual Overhaul – Lighting Reforged
This update also brings a total overhaul to how light behaves across the battlefield and inside the cockpit.

Real-Time Reflections

Cockpit interior surfaces now reflect the world around you—gunfire, muzzle flashes, and objects from outside now alter the lighting on your mech.

World-Driven Interior Lighting

Your cockpit now feels connected to the battlefield. As ambient lighting floods your cabin and interacts with the space around you dramatically raising emersion.

notes.title: Camo and Camera Toolkit Update, V1.142
notes.content:
V1.142 Camo and Camera Toolkit Update

Customization and Camo system
Deep mech customization lets pilots arm, tweak, and style their mechs exactly the way they want. This microtransaction-free, fully featured camo editor blends 25 base textures with 33 colors for limitless variation and expression, saving up to eight designs that can be applied to any unlocked mech.

Camera Toolkit
Improved Smooth Camera
The streaming camera receives major upgrades to better capture cockpit interactions and mech dynamics, such as shaking from damage or movement. Enhanced motion and action tracking brings flat-screen footage far closer to the true VR experience, with recordings now showing the authentic movement shake and stomping.

All New Camcorder
A placeable camera that lets you frame shots exactly how you want. Perfect for cinematic angles, gameplay highlights, and custom scenes with full control over position and rotation. This also benefits from a lot of tech we built for smooth camera improvements!

Custom FOV
FOV settings let you control how wide or narrow the view is for each shot. Easily switch between portrait and landscape mode to suit different platforms and styles.

Gameplay & Balance
Increased Pulse Rails accuracy and damage, adjusted spread.
Increased Intimidators damage.
Reduced Spitfire damage slightly.
Gave LR-FOS BEAM a damage increase as well.
Artillery and airstrikes now hit shields and other blocking objects.
Cloaking: Halved cost.
Heavy Shield: Doubled health.
Healing drones are now networked and appear to other players as well.

UI & UX
Improved disconnecting and reconnecting logic and information conveyed, no more black screens without a reason!
All new sound and visual effects for picking mechs, weapons, augments and camo.
Force headphones option for Standalone Quest players

Maps & Environments
Echus: Ammo increased from 8 → 12
Redland: Major update- New layout and visual improvements
Abandoned Sector: Major update- Visual improvements
Sentinel: New map- Mountaintop facility environment with tight corridors and large rooms, mid size
Canyons: New map- Desert canyon environment, mid size
Magma Fields: Minor fixes and improvements, lava plane textures fixed for standalone
Badlands: Ammo increased from 8 → 16, added spawn cover.
Bulletheim: Ammo increased from 8 → 16

Introducing New Zone Taurus Station 3—an off-world mining outpost rich in resources essential for planetary expansion. notes.title: V1.033 Update - Taurus Station 3, bug fixes, balancing and more
notes.content:
V1.033 Update

02/24/2025 

Taurus Station 3 

Our newest addition to the official map pool. Thanks to Kforce for helping us bring it to the finish line.

This zone became an important mining colony and logistical point in material processing after a discovery of an exotic underground structure



Weapon improvements and tuning:

Airstrike and artillery now get blocked by shields

FOS, Gauss and Intimidators time to kill sped up



Misc & General balancing:

We fully reworked ammo distribution throughout all maps (official and community maps)

I.e. Badlands got its ammo / mass pickups reduced from 112 down to just 8

Apparently we also had a massive issue where ammo pickups wouldn’t disappear if picked up by non host players (letting one ammo pickup be picked up by up to 8 players) that’s now fixed

Ammo pickup respawn duration increased from 30 s to 60s

Hoping that with this iteration ammo will become a relevant mechanic again and abilities will require some planning and resource management

Added a EFFECTS audio setting to give you guys the option to turn down game SFX so you can hear teammates better and what not

Improved hand interaction with the repair lever

Tuned repair lever retract time

Improved the weight of dead mechs

Adjusted mech death FX, how mechs break after death

Rewrote augment descriptions to provide actual stats

Excluded AI out of stats. KILLING AI NO LONGER COUNTS TOWARDS STATS

Still grants XP but will not give you bragging rights 

Lunar Crawler Community map by Mithril Headset


Fixes:

Datacap gamemode breaking bug turned out to be a large under the hood issue, now fixed

Moved gif button away from safe mode

Optimized airstrike FX

Adjusted fallback fade method

Fixed custom level button not doing anything

Fully reworked our tracer spawning, these are now used significantly more efficiently, in turn rockets trails should almost never disappear and performance should be better

Adjusted most tracer visuals, made trails cool-er

Fixed weapons not cloaking on cloaked mechs



Custom level loader receives a large rework:

For all map makers we're switching custom level format over to .glb 

that allows you guys to use empty objects, have a hierarchy of things with their own locations and transforms, texture packing and materials should come across waaaay easier now

We implemented a bunch of options for you guys to define in the .glb files that lets you test maps with ammo, health pickups, functioning AI and more.

More info and documentation on level loader in our discord FAQ channel



And more minor changes!!

notes.title: IRON REBELLION 1.0 LAUNCH!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36493606/219e4ca5659bbb254725cef8849e1d23cc3d7f2e.png

Iron Rebellion 1.0
Buckle up and get ready to experience piloting a 40 ton war machine like never before. After almost 8 years of development Iron Rebellion is officially out of Early Access! and into 1.0!

We spent the last 5 months ironing out any and all bugs and issues, so that every switch you flip and lever you pull has a tangible impact, making the whole experience feel more connected and responsive than ever before.


Major pillars of the game that we’ve addressed in the update:

Leaderboards
We’ve implemented multiple player stats such as your kills, favorite weapons, maps and more. This addition lets you put yourself directly against other pilots and compare achievements.

Matchmaking
Reworked from the ground up, making for smoother match to match transitions, letting people choose new maps, swap teams easily and automatically join quick matches.
A new match slot system lets you configure matches however you like—whether 1v4 bots, 2v4 players, or classic 1v1.

A.I. Overhaul
AI was massively improved with added difficulty options. Bots now manage multiple targets and predict your movements making it challenging to play against at high difficulties. We’ve had very positive feedback from early testers.

Game feel
We refined multiple small details, reworked and unified callouts, mechs now break into chunks on death, besides that we’ve improved audio mastering, completely redesigned most UI and screens to look and feel better.

Communications
Systems reworked to indicate all the relevant information to players in both lobby and in matches, You’ll now immediately see who’s talking and easily mute others - no more guesswork or searching through menus.

Unlock system
A new unlock / progression system designed to reward you for your achievements and gradually onboard players without being overwhelming.

Performance improvements
Tons of systems were optimized, simplified and updated to be more efficient and cleaner, as well as various graphical fixes, boosting frame rates and reducing headset battery drain.

Balance
Almost every weapon and game element received varying adjustments, making loadout combinations and your mech’s design’s choices even more important than before.

Map improvements
We spent a good amount of time improving visuals in multiple maps, tuning and adjusting pickups for better balancing, optimizing for smoother gameplay.

And as always if you have any feedback or just simply want to join our community https://discord.gg/WJKSETT

notes.title: Our final major update before 1.0 Abilities & Augments
notes.content:
Abilities & Augments Update Progress Log
Version: v0.9896 Release Date: 09/19/2024


Mechs / Abilities:
Each mech now has its own ability and dedicated role in battlefield.

Infiltrator light mech
Has the ability to cloak and infiltrate behind enemy lines

Recon light mech
Places scanners that sense and locate enemies in close proximity

Reinforcer heavy mech
Support class that can build defense turrets, provide health and ammo. Acts as a spawn beacon for other mechs.

Guardian heavy mech
Has the ability to place a strong defensive shield

E-pulse medium mech
Uses an electromagnetic blast to disable surrounding mechs, forcing them to reboot their systems

Breaker medium mech
This class was designed for assault and equipped with two abilities, -  request a devastating airstrike or alternatively enter a “breaker” mode which allows the mech to cope with excessive heat for a short while, allowing the pilot to go move beyond movement limits.

All mechs were retuned completely, boosting their health improving the pace of the game We significantly boosted health for all mechs in order to facilitate the newly added mechanics, gun fights are still tense but last a little longer and let you make more decisions in the meantime

Augments:
Each mech can equip up to 3 augments to fine tune their control of the mechs and strengthen specific aspects. We’ve created 16 augments for you to experiment with

Cockpit
Various screens have been reworked and adjusted, new ability screen with its own UI, physical buttons and interaction. Pinged mech screen shows information about the enemy, including its health, loadout, augments and more.

Personal augment screen added for a more detailed breakdown of mech upgrades.

Weapons
Most weapons were adjusted, improved, polished, made more satisfying and powerful. 

Maps:
Community Maps Added: IGNF Refinery, Tor Junkyard 3.0, Pastel Freighter, The Grinder, Redlands, Desert Highway, Abandoned Sector

Updated maps: Bulletheim, Badlands, and Redlands

Adjustments to ammo and health placements across all maps for better resource control.

Miscellaneous:
Ammo visibility improved with better visual cues and item size increased for easier collection.

New score/points system rewarding kills, objectives, and other tasks with points. Team kills and negative actions now reduce points.

Reticle improvement especially on scoped mode, smoother during zoom.

Flight mechanics for light mechs adjusted to increase flight time from 11 to 15 seconds.

A ton of improvements, adjustments and bug fixes

Out on live now!!

notes.title: New combat scenario (gamemode): Uplink, Cargo system.
notes.content:
v0.9313 just hit LIVE! 
-New "Uplink" combat scenario
In the Uplink combat scenario, attackers capture and synchronize with three towers using their mech's quantum processor to enable dropship communication for reinforcements. Defenders protect the towers and disrupt synchronization. Attackers gain reinforcement tickets after each successful synchronization, acting as a shared respawn pool. If they run out of tickets, they lose. Capturing all three towers secures victory. 

-3 New community maps
-Mithril City
-Bulletstorm Valley
-Pastel Freighter

-Interaction Cargo System
Interact with in game objects such as health and ammo pickups, Uplink objectives etc., through a multi-purpose retrieve-and-store cargo system (or RCS for short)
To use the RCS, simply pull the handle toward you while standing over cargo or other objects on the battlefield. in a later update pilots will be able to store, sort and release cargo to other pilots in need.

-Misc
Audio and art upgrades
Updated placeholder drones art
Healing system received an audio makeover

notes.title: New war machines are here
notes.content:
In this major update we introduce new mech classes built to thrive in all battle conditions

These three mech classes will be the foundation for all other mechs to come and will mature over time as you the community experiment with them.

Class basics

Scout
Stripped down to its bare essentials, This is a blazing fast reconnaissance mech built to get in and out of situations quickly while using the environment to its advantage. Though this mech can only carry one weapon its maneuverability makes it a formattable foe.

Assault
Versatile and built to handle any situation. This mech is the bread and butter of most battles as it is very adaptable and well rounded to any combat need.

Heavy
Armored to the teeth and built to hold strategic positions. This Fat boy may not move fast but can take on multiple mechs at one time and change the entire tide of war by simply occupying key locations

Updated Repair system
Each mech class has different amounts of repair nodes depending on its weight class. Scout class has 2, Assault class has 4, and Heavy class has 6.

Every mech has been outfitted with an updated repair touch screen to help better manage this new mechanic.

Mech damage
Mechs now display external cosmetic damage giving critical information to pilots as they choose to either engage or retreat for repairs.

notes.title: Fresh alpha release not without its problems! :D
notes.content:
Hey guys we just wanted to cover a few know bugs that have come up after we launched on steam

It seems that if you try to Wishlist the game or join the discord from the mech bay, Avast antivirus will see it as an attack for opening up your browser. If you whitelist Iron Rebellion in the Avast testings that should fix the problem until we solve it on our end. Here is a link on how to do so. https://www.getavast.net/support/managing-exceptions/


The second bug is making the game taking an incredibly long time to load new scenes, such as the (mech bay) or (battle maps) we are actively seeking these out but just wanted to let the community know we are on it!

We are very excited for the warm welcome this game has gotten and can't wait to keep adding more content as time goes on. if you guys need any help or have any questions we are active and open to help out in our discord here! https://discord.gg/WJKSETT
